actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic programs, and a PBRM1-high/VHL-high mutation pattern), but the evidence that directly bears on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows essentially no separation of the current membership from the rest in any native modality geometry (silhouettes near zero in CT and RNA, negative in WSI and WXS, with within-set and between-set distances nearly equal or reversed). No structural revision is warranted, and independent membership remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0002 has a coherent biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with up-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid metabolism; VHL-depleted, TP53-enriched mutation pattern) and positive evidence bearing on its current membership: current-label alignment shows a modest but directionally consistent separation of the current membership from the rest in all four modalities (positive silhouettes, within-set distance smaller than between-set). The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0002-K8_C0003 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry (boundary silhouette near zero) with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; the set-level membership representation for K8_C0002 remains positive, so the unit is retained.

K8_C0003 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulation of TNFA/NFKB inflammatory programs), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows little to no consistent separation of the current membership from the rest (silhouettes near zero in CT and RNA, negative in WSI, only modestly positive in WXS, with within-set versus between-set distances nearly equal or reversed in three of four modalities). The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0002-K8_C0003 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; independent membership for K8_C0003 remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0004 has an interpretable biological identity (down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with down-regulation of EMT, KRAS signaling-up, E2F targets, and coagulation), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows no consistent separation of the current membership from the rest (silhouettes negative in CT and WSI, near zero in RNA, only modestly positive in WXS, with within-set versus between-set distance direction inconsistent across modalities). The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0004-K8_C0006 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; independent membership for K8_C0004 remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0005 has a coherent biological identity (coordinated up-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with down-regulation of UV-response-DN, androgen response, and TGF-beta signaling; strong BAP1 enrichment surviving both driver-panel and global multiplicity control) and positive evidence bearing on its current membership: current-label alignment shows a weak but directionally consistent separation of the current membership from the rest in RNA, WSI, and WXS (positive silhouettes, within-set distance smaller than between-set), with no distinction in CT. The membership representation is positive in three of four modalities, so the unit is retained.

K8_C0006 has an interpretable biological identity (down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation with down-regulation of EMT, glycolysis, and MTORC1, and up-regulation of WNT beta-catenin signaling), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows separation of the current membership only in CT (silhouette 0.108) with near-zero or negative silhouettes and reversed distance direction in RNA, WSI, and WXS. The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0004-K8_C0006 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; independent membership for K8_C0006 remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0007 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulation of EMT and proliferative programs with down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation; PBRM1-depleted, VHL-enriched mutation pattern), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows essentially no separation of the current membership from the rest (silhouettes negative in CT, near zero in RNA and WSI, only modestly positive in WXS, with within-set versus between-set distances nearly equal or inconsistent in direction). No structural revision is warranted, and independent membership remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0008 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulation of cell-cycle/proliferative programs with down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs; near-universal PBRM1 mutation), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows separation of the current membership only in WSI and WXS, with negative silhouettes and reversed distance direction in CT and RNA. The membership representation is modality-specific and not consistent across geometries, so independent membership remains unsupported and the unit is not retained.
